Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2351 of 2023

Applicant :- Avinash
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Secrett. Lko.
And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Nijam Ahamad

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Ms. Shashi Lata Pandey, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri S.N. Goswami, learned
A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
317 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 Ipc, Section 3(2)(b) Sc/St Act and Sections 3/4 of
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Jalalpur, District
Ambedkar Nagar.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 28.10.20232 alleging that the applicant had enticed away the informant's minor daughter.

4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that she is aged 17 years, she loves the applicant for the past 2-3 years and that her father had beaten her up and she had insisted the applicant to take her with him.

The victim was taken for her medico legal Avinash vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127006571/
1 examination but she declined to undergo the same.

entities.text: medico legal Avinash vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C, the victim stated that after going with the applicant, she married him.

She categorically stated that she had gone with the applicant out of her own free will and being his wife, she wants to live with the applicant only.
5.

In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the FIR does not mention the date on which the applicant had allegedly enticed away the victim; that the victim has consistently stated that she loves the applicant, she married him and she wants to live with him only; that the victim declined to undergo medico legal examination and that from mere appearance, it cannot be expected that the applicant could have ascertained that the victim has not attained the age of majority, coupled with the facts that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 08.01.2023 and without making any observation,
which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
8.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
